approved: Competition and Consumer Amendment (Continuing ACCC Monitoring of Domestic Airline Competition) Bill 2023
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would make the competition watchdog keep watching domestic airline prices, costs and profits.
It would order the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission to issue a report every three months and put it online.
The monitoring would start the day after the bill becomes law.
The bill extends the ACCC's monitoring of domestic air passenger services.
It requires quarterly public reports from the ACCC.
It directs the minister to table each report in Parliament.
The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission, domestic airlines and their passengers.
